top1.title: 【2026-11-07】AI侵入テストツール「Artex」、800件超が認証なしでネット公開
top1.lead1: Censysが、AI侵入テストツールArtexの800件超の設置環境に認証なしでアクセスできると確認した。
top1.lead2: 正規の試験用途もある一方、第三者が悪用する危険が浮上。強力なAIツールでも公開設定の不備がリスクになる。

top10.title: [2026-11-07] Over 800 deployments of AI penetration-testing tool Artex exposed online without authentication
top10.summary: Censys confirmed unauthenticated access to more than 800 Artex deployments. While some serve legitimate testing purposes, it warned of the risk of misuse by third parties.

top10.title: [2026-11-07] Ramp data shows AI spending growth slowing despite increased usage, amid price competition and cost savings
top10.summary: Ramp data showed AI spending growth slowing in late summer. Despite increased usage, price cuts and operational efficiencies held spending down, before growth accelerated again in October.

top10.title: [2026-11-07] Meta introduces Spaces in Muse to create task-specific workspaces through conversation
top10.summary: Meta introduced Spaces in Muse for creating task-specific workspaces. Users can create travel plans and tracking spreadsheets through conversation and update information through integrations with external apps.

top10.title: [2026-11-07] inMusic plans to release code and offer SDKs to support AI-assisted instrument modifications
top10.summary: In a reported article, inMusic outlined plans to release code for its instruments and provide SDKs. While embracing AI-assisted modifications, it emphasizes the stability of official software and ways to restore it.

top10.title: [2026-11-07] Report: Attitudes toward AI shape romance in San Francisco's dating scene
top10.summary: An on-the-ground report by The Verge described how support for or opposition to AI, concerns about its safety, and views on work influence people's choice of romantic partners. It also examined cases of people delegating their dating activities to AI.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
editorsDesk.bonusNote: 今日のおまけアニメ。クリックで再生。

topCards.summary: Rampのデータで夏後半のAI支出の伸びが鈍化。利用量増でも値下げや運用効率化が支出を抑制し、10月には伸びが再加速した。

topCards.title: 【2026-11-07】Meta、Museに「Spaces」導入　会話から用途別の作業空間を作成
